name: tomo
description: A desktop companion for international students in Japan, built on Hermes Agent.

scripts.lint: eslint src test electron.vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.test:e2e: electron-vite build && node test/e2e/smoke.mjs && node test/e2e/window.mjs && node test/e2e/first-run.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('release',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node scripts/fetch-uv.mjs && node scripts/prepare-packs.mjs && electron-vite build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --publish never -c.electronDownload.cache=.dev/cache/electron
scripts.dist:win: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('release',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node scripts/fetch-uv.mjs win32-x64 && node scripts/prepare-packs.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never -c.electronDownload.cache=.dev/cache/electron

author: Tomo contributors
